description: Test class for CustomersController using Spring's MockMvc framework; contains unit tests for listing, creating, and deleting customers.

classes.name: test_CustomersControllerWebMvcTest
classes.description: A Spring Boot WebMvcTest class for testing CustomersController endpoints using mock MVC environment.

methods.name: list_returnsArrayOfCustomers
methods.description: Tests the GET /api/customers endpoint to ensure it returns an array of customer DTOs.

methods.name: create_whenValid_returns201AndBody
methods.description: Tests the POST /api/customers endpoint to ensure it creates a new customer and returns the created DTO with status 201.

methods.name: create_whenMissingRequiredFields_returns400
methods.description: Tests that missing required fields in POST request return a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: delete_returns204
methods.description: Tests the DELETE /api/customers/{id} endpoint to ensure it returns a 204 No Content status.
